name: Jeroham
title: Samuel's grandfather and Levite
summary: Jeroham was a Levite from the hill country of Ephraim and the father of Elkanah, who in turn was the father of the prophet Samuel. He is mentioned in the genealogies in both 1 Samuel and 1 Chronicles. Through his grandson Samuel, Jeroham played an indirect but important role in Israel's history, as Samuel became one of the greatest prophets and judges in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Samuel's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jeroham is named as the father of Elkanah in the introduction to the story of Samuel's birth, where his family line is presented.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jeroham is listed in the Levitical genealogy that connects Samuel to the tribe of Levi through the Kohathite branch.

keyEvents.title: Elkanah's Family and Piety
keyEvents.description: Jeroham's son Elkanah continued the family's devotion and traveled annually to Shiloh to worship the Lord, testifying to a godly family tradition.

keyEvents.title: Samuel's Birth – Jeroham's Grandson
keyEvents.description: Through Elkanah and Hannah, Samuel, the grandson of Jeroham, was born in answer to prayer and dedicated to the Lord's service from childhood.

keyEvents.title: Levitical Service in the Genealogy
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Jeroham is linked to the Levitical singing service, where Samuel's descendants served at the tabernacle and later at the temple.
